_comment: Gate scan identity per page (T13B). A page's own role guard decides which identity scans it: a student-only page redirects admin sessions away, which fake-reds route-stable family checks. Default identity stays admin (EDU_GATE_TOKEN); a listed page scans under EDU_GATE_<ROLE>_TOKEN when that env is set, else falls back to the admin token unchanged. Gate semantics never weaken: only the scan identity is aligned with the page guard, no check is skipped or relaxed.
